question: Based on the four-digit number visible on the building exterior after the individual positioned in front of the large ornate frame within the gallery setting containing several large-scale portraits while discussing a specific likeness from the year 1640 mentions a newly built home, identify the specific animals suspended from the ceiling in the room containing various classical sculptures plus anatomical models positioned between the primary entrance door plus the tiered display cases containing smaller biological specimens to show the diversity of items collected within that structure.
